the proposed World War II internment
camp Monument proposal memorializes the
hardship of over 120 000 people of
Japanese German Italian and Japanese
Peruvian descent who were incarcerated
in the United States during that time
the World War II Camp Memorial is the
vision of Mr kanji Sahara his family was
incarcerated at the Santa Anita Assembly
Center the artist and architect of the
memorial is Roger yanagita who also
designed the goal for broke monument in
LA's Little Tokyo the memorial committee
and its president Nancy hayata have
provided key information research and
Leadership for this project
the memorial was first presented to the
city council in 2019 and was referred at

Commission

committee sought funding for the project
to advance IT staff remained in contact
